title: Compute crack initiation angle and failure stress
action: Implement the crack initiation model. For each pre-existing crack angle β in 0°, 10°, ..., 90°, numerically solve the equation sin(2(β+γ)) = 2.5·cos(β)·cos(γ) for γ (in radians). Then compute the failure pressure p = 19.0·cot(γ) / sin(2(γ+β)). Collect results as rows with columns beta (in degrees), gamma (in degrees), and p (in g/cm²). Save to crack_initiation_results.csv.
description: CSV file with predicted crack initiation angle γ (degrees) and failure pressure p (g/cm²) for each pre-existing crack angle β (0° to 90° in 10° steps).
output_schema: CSV with header: beta,gamma,p. Each row: beta (float, angle in degrees), gamma (float, predicted new crack angle in degrees), p (float, failure pressure in g/cm²).
